Encoder command:

- Encoder settings passed to FFMpeg, can be manually tweaked.

Encoder:

- Compression algorithm for video, most common is libx264

- Any encoder without a device label is a CPU encoder.

- Lossy Encoders:

- libx264 (mkv, mp4, mov, avi)

- libx265 (mkv, mp4, mov)

- vp9 (mkv, webm)

- av1 (mkv, mp4, webm)

- Lossless Encoders:

- prores (mkv, mov)

- ffv1 (mkv, avi)

Encoder Speed:

- Speed at which the encoder processes the video, Slower processing time means Better results for the file size.

Video Container

- Changes the video container in the default output file generated container.

- mkv is recomended due to its extensive support for different formats.

WARNING: Changing this MAY break encoder compadibility.

Please look at the audio and video encoder tooltips for compadibility.

Pixel Format

- Defines how color information is stored for each pixel in a video frame.

- yuv420p: Most common, removes the most information. (mkv, mp4, mov, avi, webm)

- yuv422p: In between 420p and 444p. (mkv, mov, mp4)

- yuv444p: Keeps the most information. (mkv, mov, mp4)

- yuv 420/422/444 p10le: 10 bit version of each. (MKV and MP4 containers only) (mkv, mov, mp4)

Audio Encoder

- Recommended to use aac if the video container is not mkv, or if the output video has audio isses.

- copy_audio: No re-encoding is done on the output

- aac: Most common, and high quality.

- libmp3lame: Used less, low quality.

- opus: Used for webm.

Audio Bitrate

- Higher bitrate = higher quality

- Only applies to aac and libmp3lame.

Subtitle Encoder

- Recommended to use webvtt if the video container is not mkv, or if the output video has audio isses.

Scene Change Detection Enabled:

- Enabled: Attempts to detect when scenes change in a video.

When running an interpolation, it will avoide interpolating over these scene changes.

Scene Change Detection Method

- mean: fastest, least accurate

- mean (segmented): fast, prone to overdetection

- pyscenedetect: slow, accuate (Recommended)

Scene Change Detection Threshold

- Lower number: higher chance of detecting scene changes, with risk of overdetection.

- Higher number: lower chance of detecting scene changes, with risk of underdetection.

- Recommended: 2-3 for real life, 4 for animation.

Audo Border Cropping:

- Will automatically remove black bars if they are present throughout a video, can increase performance.

Precision:

- Auto: Defaults to float16 if the GPU is supported (RTX 20 series and up)

- Float16: Faster inference and less VRAM usage.

- Float32: Slower inference and more VRAM usage, supported on more GPUS.

TensorRT Optimization Level:

- Lower means less optimization, but faster engine generation time.

- Higher means more optimization, but slower engine generation time.

Auto HDR Mode

- Auto enables HDR mode if RVE detects that the video that is being rendered is HDR. This will cause slower rendering if the video is HDR.

- HDR is only color tested on x264 and x265 encoders.

- The preview colors may be distorted as the preview itself is not HDR.

TensorRT Dynamic Engine:

- Enables TensorRT to build for many different resolutions in one engine.
Saves VRAM and speeds up inference at resolutions above 1080p by calculating flow at a lower resolution. (GMFSS/GIMM)
